assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire refers to domestic tasks only within categories of inactivity, reasons for not seeking work (such as SECCIÓN 6, PARTE A, Pregunta 8: 'Se dedica exclusivamente a las labores del hogar'), or reasons for working fewer hours than usual (SECCIÓN 6, PARTE B, Pregunta 5: 'Demasiado ocupado en tareas del hogar, estudio,etc'). Per the indicator definition: 1) Responsibility: The instrument does not ask who is responsible for, in charge of, or plans unpaid domestic or care work. 2) Performance: The instrument does not ask whether a person carries out domestic or care tasks; options indicating domestic work as a reason for inactivity or not working do not count. 3) Magnitude: The instrument does not record the time or frequency spent on unpaid domestic or care work.
